title: Financial Consultancy Services in Nepal | Lalitpur Advisory
metaDescription: Strategic financial consultancy services in Nepal. Tailored budgeting, cash-flow structuring, bookkeeping setup, and compliance advisory for businesses and individuals.
directAnswer: Financial consultancy services in Nepal provide individuals, startups, and established enterprises with expert financial management, cash-flow structuring, budgeting, and compliance guidance. Lalitpur Financial Advisory helps clients navigate local commercial complexities, optimize working capital, and establish reliable financial control across all seven provinces.
centerpieceSubtitle: Identify the exact financial advisory scope tailored to your organizational scale and commercial challenge.

sections.h2: Core Financial Consultancy Disciplines We Deliver
sections.contentHtml:
Our consultancy provides end-to-end financial stewardship designed for the Nepalese market. We do not provide cookie-cutter advice; each engagement begins with a diagnostic evaluation of your balance sheet, operating cash flows, and compliance standing.

Corporate Financial Planning

Comprehensive operational budgeting, capital expenditure scheduling, and scenario modeling to safeguard profitability against market volatility.

Working Capital Management

Streamlining accounts receivable collection cycles, optimizing inventory holdings, and managing supplier credit lines.

Internal Controls & Systems

Establishing robust record-keeping protocols, voucher approval hierarchies, and fraud-resistant financial operations.

Compliance & Audit Readiness

Pre-audit ledger reconciliation, tax documentation consolidation, and coordinating with independent ICAN statutory auditors.

sections.h2: Who Our Financial Advisory Services Help
sections.contentHtml:
We serve a diverse cross-section of commercial entities and individuals across Nepal:

  • Founders & Startups: Structuring financial models, establishing initial charts of accounts, and forecasting runway before commercial launch.
  • Growing SMEs: Overcoming cash-flow crunches, preparing bankable credit proposals, and institutionalizing bookkeeping.
  • Established Enterprises: Cost-center variance analysis, profitability auditing, and operational restructuring.
  • High-Net-Worth Individuals: Household budgeting, asset-allocation strategies, and long-term liquidity planning.

1

Diagnostic Consultation

An initial 45-minute discovery session reviewing your historical financials, current operational friction, and commercial objectives.

2

Financial Health Audit

In-depth examination of cash conversion cycles, margins, debts, tax filings, and internal controls to pinpoint vulnerabilities.

3

Strategic Roadmap & Deliverables

Formulation of customized financial models, forecasting dashboards, internal control SOPs, and actionable monthly targets.

4

Implementation & Monthly Review

Ongoing monthly or quarterly steering sessions tracking variance against forecast and adjusting strategies dynamically.

Transparency is foundational to our practice. Lalitpur Financial Advisory operates as an independent management consulting practice. In accordance with the Nepal Chartered Accountants Act 2053, statutory independent financial audits must be performed by certified members of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nepal (ICAN). Our consultancy prepares businesses for audits and coordinates seamlessly with licensed audit firms, but we do not issue statutory audit opinions.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a financial consultant and an accountant?
faqs.answer: An accountant primarily focuses on recording historical transactions, balancing ledgers, and preparing statutory financial statements. A financial consultant is forward-looking: analyzing historical data to build growth forecasts, optimize cash flow, structure capital, and drive strategic business decisions.

faqs.question: Do you provide services to businesses located outside Lalitpur and Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: Yes. While our headquarters is situated in Lalitpur, we support commercial clients and individual entrepreneurs across all seven provinces of Nepal via secure digital channels and scheduled onsite reviews.

faqs.question: How are advisory engagements priced?
faqs.answer: We offer transparent engagement models: project-based consulting for specific modeling or setup tasks, and retained advisory packages for ongoing monthly financial oversight.
